subject: Request: SDLC evidence for SIG — CI/CD, secret rotation & change ownership
summary: External assessor requested timeline and artifacts for code review gating, CI/CD enforcement, and secrets rotation. Internal owners collated pipeline snippets, protected-branch rules, rotation logs and a change approval chronology and delivered them; assessor confirmed receipt and asked one follow-up about RBAC ownership.
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@northbridge-assess.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-16 09:12 PST
Subject: SIG follow-up — SDLC artifacts needed (code review, CI/CD enforcement, secrets)

Hi Irene / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. As part of the SIG evidence bundle for Northbridge we need artifact-level proof for a few SDLC controls:

- Code review gating: PR protection settings, an example PR that was blocked by policy, and who the approvers are.
- CI/CD enforcement: pipeline policy snippets (lint/OPA/rego), details on who can trigger deploys and how canary rollouts are authorized.
- Secrets management: proof of rotation events (last 12 months) and who has admin access to the vault.
- Change approval chronology: a simple CSV showing approvals for a recent production change (owners, timestamps, approver ids).

Can you share these artifacts (redacted where necessary) by 2025-11-19 so we can include them in the SIG submission? If any item is sensitive, please point us at a secure share (Drive/Box) and we can pull from there.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Assessor — Northbridge Risk Partners

---
(Please include filenames in your reply)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: liam.oconnor@northbridge-assess.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-16 10:03 PST
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — SDLC artifacts needed (code review, CI/CD enforcement, secrets)

Hi Liam — thanks for the checklist. We're assembling the artifacts and will provide redacted extracts where appropriate. Quick clarifications:

1) For the "example PR" do you prefer a recent security fix PR or a routine feature PR where OPA prevented merging? We can produce both but will likely include the OPA-blocked feature PR as it demonstrates enforcement.
2) Vault admin list — do you need full IAM principal ARNs or just role names and counts?

Plan: Karthik will export rotation records and the change chronology; Marissa will extract pipeline snippets and the PR example. I'll deliver links and filenames by EOD 2025-11-17; full files by 2025-11-18.

Irene Choi
Principal Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments to follow: list of filenames in next message.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-17 08:22 PST
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — SDLC artifacts needed (code review, CI/CD enforcement, secrets)

Forwarding the export I ran this morning. Attachments: secret-rotation-log-2025Q3.csv (redacted principal ids), change-approval-chronology-2025.csv (recent PROD change entries).

Notes:
- Rotation log includes timestamp, secret id hash, rotate_type (auto/manual), actor_role (service_account/admin). We redacted ticket ids per privacy.
- Change chronology is chronological (UTC) with approver name and role; approvals that happened via delegation are flagged in the "approval_method" column.

Drive location (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3X-redwood-sdlc-evidence (access granted to northbridge-assess@example.com).

Attachments (stubs):
- secret-rotation-log-2025Q3.csv
- change-approval-chronology-2025.csv

Karthik Iyer
Security Engineering Manager — CI/CD & Secrets
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-17 14:05 PST
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — SDLC artifacts needed (code review, CI/CD enforcement, secrets)

Posted the pipeline snippets and the PR sample to the shared Drive folder. Summary of artifacts included:

- ci-pipeline-policy-extracts.pdf — excerpts showing our OPA gate, lint step, and protected env enforcement. Includes the pipeline stage names and the policy id (policy: pr-merge-guard-v2).
- example PR: PR #4827 (feature -> main) — shows OPA failing check, reviewer request, and subsequent fix; header contains commit hashes (redacted).
- Branch protections: main has required status checks, 2 approvers from the security or platform teams, and disallow-force-push enabled.
- Who can trigger deploys: role-based run policies (roles: infra-deploy, release-manager). Manual canary is gated by web UI approval from release-manager or security lead.

If the assessor needs a video walk-through of the deploy gating we can record a 5–7 minute clip; otherwise the policy extracts + example PR should suffice.

Marissa Cole
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments (stubs): ci-pipeline-policy-extracts.pdf

From: security@verisage-audit.com <security@verisage-audit.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: liam.oconnor@northbridge-assess.com
Date: 2025-11-18 15:30 PST
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — SDLC artifacts needed (code review, CI/CD enforcement, secrets)

Hi Irene / team,

Thanks — we pulled the files from the Drive link and have the artifacts: ci-pipeline-policy-extracts.pdf, secret-rotation-log-2025Q3.csv, change-approval-chronology-2025.csv. The examples show enforcement and traceability clearly. A couple quick follow-ups before we close the ticket:

- Can you confirm who owns the role "release-manager" (principal name) for RBAC mapping in the SIG? We need to map that back to a headcount/role entry.
- For the redacted PR hashes: can you provide a mapping file that shows anonymized hash -> internal PR id so we can reference it in the report (no real commit content required)?

If you can drop those two small items in the same secure folder by 2025-11-20, we should be able to finalize the SIG submission.

Regards,
Verisage Security Intake
security@verisage-audit.com
